label: US-WA-SB5152-synthmedia-elections-2023 Sec. 2

obligations.text: (a) For visual media, the text of the disclosure must appear in size easily readable by the average viewer and no smaller than the largest font size of other text appearing in the visual media.
If the visual media does not include any other text, the disclosure must appear in a size that is easily readable by the average viewer.

For visual media that is a video, the disclosure must appear for the duration of the video; or
(b) If the media consists of audio only, the disclosure must be read in a clearly spoken manner and in a pitch that can be easily heard by the average listener, at the beginning of the audio, at the end of the audio, and, if the audio is greater than two minutes in length, interspersed within the audio at intervals of not more than two minutes each.
